name: Cryptoway Payments – Crypto Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: cryptoway

sections.description:
Documentation | Create account | Pricing | Supported Coins | Contact

Cryptoway Payments for WooCommerce adds cryptocurrency checkout to WooCommerce stores through Cryptoway.

When a customer selects Cryptoway at checkout, the plugin creates a Cryptoway invoice for the WooCommerce order and redirects the customer to the Cryptoway payment page. After the payment status changes, Cryptoway sends a signed webhook to the store and the WooCommerce order status is updated automatically.

The plugin is designed for merchants who want to add crypto payments to WooCommerce while keeping the standard WooCommerce checkout, order management, and fulfillment process.

Store Checkout Features

  • Add Cryptoway as a WooCommerce payment method
  • Create Cryptoway payment invoices from WooCommerce orders
  • Redirect customers to the Cryptoway payment page
  • Update WooCommerce order status through webhooks
  • Verify incoming webhooks with Callback Key Secret
  • Support WooCommerce Checkout Blocks
  • Support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Configure invoice lifetime
  • Choose whether the buyer or merchant pays the service fee
  • Check payment status manually from the WooCommerce order screen
  • Enable debug logging during setup and troubleshooting

Coins and Networks

Cryptoway supports popular cryptocurrencies and stablecoins. See the full list on the Supported Coins page.

Popular Assets:

  • Bitcoin (BTC)
  • Ethereum (ETH)
  • Tether (USDT)
  • BNB
  • Litecoin (LTC)
  • Toncoin (TON)
  • Tron (TRX)

USDT Networks:

  • USDT ERC-20
  • USDT TRC-20
  • USDT on TON

The exact list of available assets and networks may depend on your Cryptoway merchant settings and enabled payment options.

Pricing

Cryptoway pricing starts from 0.3% per successful incoming transaction. See current fees on the Cryptoway Pricing page.

Security and Webhooks

  • API Key ID and API Key Secret are used for invoice creation
  • Callback Key Secret is used for signed webhook verification
  • Webhook requests are checked before WooCommerce order data is updated
  • Customers complete payment on the Cryptoway payment page
  • The plugin does not ask customers to enter wallet credentials on the WooCommerce checkout page

Setup in WooCommerce

After activation, go to: WooCommerce -> Settings -> Payments -> Cryptoway

You can configure:

  • API Key ID
  • API Key Secret
  • Callback Key Secret
  • Payment method title
  • Payment method description
  • Invoice lifetime
  • Fee payer setting
  • Debug mode

Support

Need help with setup or testing?

  • Support email: support@cryptoway.com
  • Telegram support: @cryptoway_support_bot
  • Sales: leo@cryptoway.com
  • Contacts page: cryptoway.com/en/contacts
  • Documentation: docs.cryptoway.com

You can also use the WordPress support forum for plugin-specific questions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cryptoway-payments directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce -> Settings -> Payments.
  5. Enable Cryptoway.
  6. Add your Cryptoway API credentials.
  7. Configure invoice lifetime and fee settings.
  8. Save changes.
  9. Place a test order to confirm invoice creation and webhook status updates.
sections.faq:
What is Cryptoway Payments for WooCommerce?

Cryptoway Payments is a WooCommerce payment gateway that allows online stores to accept crypto payments through Cryptoway.

How do I accept crypto payments in WooCommerce?

Install the plugin, activate Cryptoway in WooCommerce payment settings, add your Cryptoway API credentials, and place a test order. Customers will then be able to choose Cryptoway at checkout.

Which cryptocurrencies does Cryptoway support?

Cryptoway supports popular cryptocurrencies and stablecoins. The full list is available on the Supported Coins page.

Does Cryptoway support USDT payments?

Yes. Cryptoway supports USDT payments, including ERC-20, TRC-20 and TON networks, depending on your merchant configuration.

How much does Cryptoway cost?

Cryptoway pricing starts from 0.3% per successful incoming transaction. See the current fees on the Pricing page.

Does the plugin work with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes. Cryptoway Payments includes support for WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

Does the plugin support High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Are WooCommerce orders updated automatically?

Yes. Cryptoway sends signed webhook notifications to the store, and the plugin updates the WooCommerce order status based on the payment status.

Can I configure invoice lifetime?

Yes. The invoice lifetime can be configured in the Cryptoway payment settings.

Can the buyer pay the service fee?

Yes. The plugin includes a setting that allows the service fee to be added to the buyer’s payment amount. If disabled, the fee is handled on the merchant side.

Where can I find logs?

Enable debug mode in the Cryptoway payment settings, then go to WooCommerce -> Status -> Logs and select the Cryptoway Payments log.

Does the plugin store customer wallet credentials?

No. Customers complete payment through the Cryptoway payment page. The plugin does not collect wallet credentials on the WooCommerce checkout page.

Where can I contact Cryptoway support?

You can contact Cryptoway at support@cryptoway.com, through Telegram, or through the Contacts page.

  • Added Cryptoway invoice creation.
  • Added signed webhook handling.
  • Added automatic WooCommerce order status updates.
  • Added manual payment status check.
  • Added WooCommerce Checkout Blocks support.
  • Added WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage compatibility.
  • Added configurable invoice lifetime.
  • Added buyer or merchant fee payer setting.
  • Added optional debug logging.
